gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant strengthening of prior year reserves totaling GBP 31.7 million in 2014, representing 30.31% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by loss information emerging from closed years, particularly the primary Professional Indemnity (PI) book, which showed later claims development than anticipated. Specific adverse movements included a GBP 4.0 million strengthening in the PI excess of loss account and a GBP 6.8 million deterioration in Directors & Officers (D&O) business, partly attributed to a London market MGA. The overall claims deterioration was also linked to the lingering effects of the Global Credit Crunch and detrimental economic conditions impacting older underwriting years, including 2011, 2012, and 2013.
